title: a finding that quotes the marker grammar
body:
- **Observed** ✗: the pass appends `<!-- prio: band=p3 score=5 sev=3 reach=1 conf=2 occ=1 basis=abc at=2026-10-24 -->` on the body's last line.

The same grammar, as an excerpt:

```
<!-- prio: band=p3 score=5 sev=3 reach=1 conf=2 occ=1 basis=abc at=2026-10-24 -->
```

- **Reproduced** on #292's own body, whose prose line ends at the close: <!-- prio: band=p3 score=5 sev=3 reach=1 conf=2 occ=1 basis=abc at=2026-10-24 -->

<!-- prio: band=p3 score=5 sev=3 reach=1 conf=2 occ=1 basis=abc at=2026-10-24 --> is the grammar the pass writes, quoted here at column 0 and continued after the close.

That span is a quotation of the grammar, not a record of this item.
